content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Compliance Review & Sales Performance Alignment
agenda_items: Upcoming training needs for sales team on updated compliance protocols
Feedback session on recent regulatory changes impacting international bookings
key_decisions: Prioritize Q3 sales efforts on high-margin, low-compliance-risk destinations.
Implement bi-weekly compliance checkpoints for all international sales deals.
